title: SQL Server Connection Problem
author: kaansengul
body_snippet:
I did clean install and wrote SQL Server connection properties (IP, dbo account username and password). If I hit "Test Connection" it does not indicate success or not. If I hit "Apply", application freezes.

I'm using SQL Server 2022 on Linux. I can successfully connect via SSMS.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Hi @kaansengul, thanks for reporting! 

**About "Test Connection" not showing results:** The test button should show a spinner and then success/failure message. If nothing happens, it could be a UI rendering issue. Can you wait 10-15 seconds after clicking? The SQL connection attempt has a timeout.

**About "Apply" freezing:** This is a known limitation. When you click Apply with "Use SQL Server" enabled, the application tries to connect to the SQL database **synchronously on the UI thread** to ...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Fixed in `f8914dc`! 🔧

The SQL connection now runs on a **background thread** with:
- 30-second timeout
- Spinner + "Connecting..." feedback while connecting
- All SQL controls disabled during the operation
- Success/failure message shown when done

The UI will no longer freeze when Apply is clicked. The fix is in the upcoming nightly build.

Please test and let us know! 🙏
